title: Closing the Loop: analysis code and derived data
description:
Analysis code and derived data for "Closing the Loop: A Feedback Framework Linking the Infodemic and the Epidemic for Risk-Communication Decisions" by Lulu Alarfaj, Nimisha Rawat, Westyn Branch-Elliman and Melissa Zeynep Ertem.

This is the version behind the manuscript submitted to Nature Human Behaviour: 22 analysis scripts and 20 derived datasets, all state-level aggregates computed from public sources. No data were collected from human participants.

Contents are described in README.md. The environment is pinned in requirements.txt (Python 3.11.9). Released under the MIT licence.
